## Void Deck 0.2.6

- Replaces the red focus treatment with a white focus border.
- Removes the accent underline from the selected Home tab.
- Prevents dot-matrix game titles from clipping at their lower edge.
- Adds clearance between a selected game cover and its title and play-time caption.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.6.zip` from this release.
